{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Fuzzy''' was the name of an award-winning [[Xuvva]] that was adopted by [[Yarvok]], the leader of the [[Nova Blades]]. [[Krupo]], a beast wrangler, lost Fuzzy along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship carrying the pets crashed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], much to Yarvok's anger. Yarvok threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets, including Fuzzy, were not found.<ref name="Codex" />

When the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] landed on Dantooine to investigate reports of [[Darth Malgus]] at the [[Jedi Enclave]], Fuzzy could be seen with several of Yarvok's other lost pets, [[Yug]] and [[Ol' Cronchy]], wandering near the Enclave's approach. Fuzzy had a preference for the crash-landed shipments of [[Galma (fruit)|Galma]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] scattered in the area.<ref name="Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fuzzy appeared in the flashpoint Secrets of the Enclave and was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
